raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 7, Reason for Mistake: The Planner compared only the month/day and ignored the years, concluding July 24 (1952) is later than May 23 (1965). Since 1965 is later than 1952, Massimo Ceccherini (Lucignolo) was born later than Gus Van Sant.
